# [1.3.0-dev.2](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/compare/v1.3.0-dev.1...v1.3.0-dev.2) (2026-10-06)


### Bug Fixes

* **tiktok:** retain selector flags across Patcher runtime versions ([38facb4](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/commit/38facb42dec2073c5a759a21491a415db09ba8a4))





## 1.3.0-dev.2

## Manager Patcher 1.15.1 compatibility fix

Fixes the reported `NoSuchMethodError: TikTokFingerprint.getAccessFlags()` while applying Feed filter with Manager 1.34.1-dev.1 / Patcher 1.15.1. Selector evidence now reads the declared access-flag mask from a getter owned by this bundle. Exact access-flag matching, missing/ambiguous hook failures, APK hash verification and native mutation contracts remain active.

The failure was reproduced using the published 1.3.0-dev.1 bundle and the actual Patcher 1.15.1 binary. The corrected CI bundle and published 1.3.0-dev.2 both pass the same selector-resolution probe. Android DEX also contains the corrected call and defines its target getter.

[Manager runtime CI](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37424982193) passes 37/37 patches and APK rebuilding for global 46.7.3 and the pinned 47.1.3 APK using Patcher 1.15.1 (hash-pinned Desktop 1.18.1). All 128 Kotlin/Android tests and 17 Python tests pass. All 11 stored original baseline contract fields are preserved (165 methods, 104 classes). These catalog tests cover this bundle's 37 TikTok patches; additional patches from another source and device behavior require separate testing.

## TikTok 47.1.3 device test

Update the BlueIT source in Morphe to **1.3.0-dev.2**, or import [patches-1.3.0-dev.2.mpp](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/releases/download/v1.3.0-dev.2/patches-1.3.0-dev.2.mpp). Retry patching the [pinned global TikTok 47.1.3 APK](https://d.apkpure.net/b/APK/com.zhiliaoapp.musically?versionCode=2024701030), package `com.zhiliaoapp.musically`, versionCode `2024701030`, original SHA-256 `8b5569f592a5534652ae460ef1d9e7f7394b5b7fdde44ae64f106d76767e2622`.

47.1.3 passes this dev bundle without force or an experimental environment opt-in. Device regression testing remains pending; the candidate is unqualified and excluded from stable-channel builds.

Published MPP: 2,221,821 bytes, SHA-256 `78f0930b780d32036b3257599110b626a5e75a182c6f6e777b66bd053014f516`. All 497 class, DEX, extension and contract entries match the CI-tested bundle byte-for-byte. The manifest, asset and Morphe metadata all report 1.3.0-dev.2. Main and stable remain unchanged.

[Release workflow](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37425811498). Tested fix commit: `38facb42dec2073c5a759a21491a415db09ba8a4`.

[Complete baseline acceptance](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37424985946) also passes final DEX discovery and baseline self-comparison on the exact fix commit.
